directory.existing_product_path: live_service._overview projects bounds from a normalized full capture. A slim directory entry would reuse that geometry projection and validation.
directory.current_host_behavior: capture_scene obtains full evaluated geometry. A slim model-facing directory does not make that internal geometry capture or transfer free.

selected.composition: Project requested geometry and the existing pair facts from the same selected capture consumed by task_query. The primary geometry objects are already within its four-object union.
selected.existing_read_context: ReadContext.activate/normalized/result and host residency retain their existing roles. No additional cache is introduced.
selected.source_requirement: A future live entry must compare the actual host generation across directory and selection, then return geometry and facts bound to the selected observation. The offline fixture does not establish live currentness.

primary.implicit_third_read: No third geometry acquisition is required by the primary field set in this frozen source. Two live calls remain a plan pending integration. Model choice of calls is unmeasured.

optional_supplement_union.gap: The eight-object optional union exceeds capture_task_scene's four-selector contract. A caller-visible full-scene fallback or a broader selection contract would require a separate implementation and cost review. It is not counted as an existing one-capture capability.

reasonable_native_comparison.relation_cost_scope: Stored relation facts are supplied equally to both offline projectors. This compares delivery cost after those facts exist. Obtaining or computing equivalent facts in an actual native-only task is outside this measurement.
reasonable_native_comparison.wire_scope: Measured bytes are the two encoded projection responses. They exclude unobserved future host transport and provider tokens.
reasonable_native_comparison.code_scope: Both are executable reusable projections. The offline benchmark does not measure model-generated code or inference cost.

source_scope: The input binds two saved records from one actor and exactly matches selected local geometry and pose. It is a frozen derived view, not a new atomic or fresh host capture.
source_correction: input/ retains the first raw-polygon fixture. input_02/ uses actual captured triangles for the four relation-capture objects before correctness and performance measurements.
